title: Tool pack meta.json
description: skills/faion/tools/<pack>/meta.json. One meta.json per pack directory gates its scripts and its cards. A pack without meta.json inherits the skill-level tier silently, which is why the file is required rather than optional. Enforced by scripts/validate-tools.py.

slug.description: Pack identity in the tier manifest. Suffixed -tools so a pack slug can never collide with a tool name.

tier.description: Gate for every script and card in the pack. A fragment that names a tool must be gated at or above the tool's tier, or the instruction is uninvokable for the user who can read it.

summary.description: What the pack holds, named tool by tool. Copied verbatim into tools/INDEX.xml, where it is the only thing an agent reads before deciding whether a tool already exists for its job.
